name: Rausu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Rausu town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing the character 羅.
history: Municipal flag of Rausu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 September 1970.

features.role: Rausu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing the character 羅
